note: Circuit templates for Copper's deterministic generator (src/v2_src/template_gen.c). A language model only analyses the request; it never chooses parts, pins, nets or values. Pins are mapped by NAME (or by number for unnamed pins) and resolved to numbers from the installed KiCad libraries at generation time; each footprint pad equals its symbol pin number, which the grounding gate re-checks. Defaults are engineering choices of this template, recorded with their reason; they are not part ratings.
component_terms_note: Scope check (template_gen.c): every term below that occurs in the prompt as a word (plural -s/-es accepted, case-insensitive; the longest term wins) must be in the chosen template's 'covers' list (built on the board) or 'offboard' list (connected, reported as such), otherwise the run is NOT_IMPLEMENTED and names the term, so a request is never silently reduced to a smaller circuit. Add a term here when a new kind of part or function should be caught.

low_side_switch.offboard_why: the switch is driven through J2 by an off-board logic source (for example a microcontroller GPIO) and switches an off-board load wired to J1; Copper cannot tell from the words alone whether a prompt wants these ON the board
low_side_switch.description: N-channel MOSFET low-side switch: a logic signal drives the gate through a series resistor, a pull-down keeps the MOSFET off when the input floats, an optional diode clamps the load's flyback voltage.

routing.why: template choice for the load path, NOT computed from the load current (Copper has no current-capacity data): check the copper width for your load current

gate_resistor_ohm.why: template default: limits the gate charging current from the logic pin and damps ringing

pulldown_ohm.why: template default: holds the gate low when the logic input is floating

flyback_diode.why: template default: clamps the voltage spike of an inductive load (motor, relay, solenoid)

parts.role: screw terminal: 1 supply +, 2 supply GND, 3 load +, 4 load -
logic header: 1 control input, 2 logic ground, 3 not connected
gate series resistor
gate pull-down
N-channel MOSFET (SOT-23, pins G-S-D)
flyback diode across the load (cathode to supply +)

led_indicator.description: A supply-powered LED with a series current-limiting resistor.

routing.why: every net carries only the LED current: the default track width

led_current_ma.why: template default: a modest indicator current

led_forward_voltage_v.why: template ASSUMPTION for a red LED: Copper has no LED datasheet data, so the real forward voltage is UNVERIFIED

parts.role: supply input: 1 +, 2 GND
LED series resistor
indicator LED

esp32_led.description: ESP32-WROOM-32 module powered through a 3.3 V AMS1117 LDO, with the EN reset RC network and reset button, a BOOT button on IO0, a 3-pin UART header for flashing, and an LED with series resistor on IO4.

sources.what: EN RC delay R = 10 kOhm, C = 1 uF; 22 uF on the module's 3V3 supply (peripheral schematic)
ESP32-WROOM-32 is marked NOT RECOMMENDED FOR NEW DESIGNS
AMS1117: 10 uF on the input, 22 uF (tantalum) on the output for stability
sources.source: AMS1117 datasheet copies, e.g. https://files.waveshare.com/upload/b/b8/AMS1117-datasheet.pdf (maximum input voltage differs between copies: not used)

esp32_led.limits_why: template scope, not part ratings: the minimum leaves headroom for the LDO's dropout, the maximum keeps the LDO's dissipation small because Copper does no thermal analysis

routing.why: template choice for the supply nets, NOT computed from the module's current: check the copper width

keepouts.why: the antenna keep-out drawn on the courtyard of KiCad's ESP32-WROOM-32 footprint: no tracks or vias on either layer

rail_voltage_v.why: the AMS1117-3.3 output that powers the module and drives the LED from IO4

design_current_a.why: template ASSUMPTION for the module's supply current, used only to estimate the LDO's dissipation (Wi-Fi transmit peaks); UNVERIFIED

led_current_ma.why: template default: a modest indicator current

led_forward_voltage_v.why: template ASSUMPTION for a red LED: Copper has no LED datasheet data, so the real forward voltage is UNVERIFIED

parts.role: ESP32 module; the antenna keep-out of its footprint is the top of the board; pins 17-22 (internal flash) are left unconnected
supply input: 1 +, 2 GND
LDO input capacitor (AMS1117 datasheet: 10 uF)
3.3 V LDO; KiCad's AMS1117-3.3 symbol is derived, so its base AP1117-15 gives the same SOT-223 pinout (1 GND, 2 VO, 3 VI)
LDO output capacitor (AMS1117 datasheet: 22 uF for stability)
module supply capacitor (Espressif peripheral schematic: 22 uF)
EN pull-up of the RC reset delay (Espressif: 10 kOhm)
EN capacitor of the RC reset delay (Espressif: 1 uF)
reset button: pulls EN low
boot button: hold IO0 low during reset to enter the serial bootloader
flashing header: 1 GND, 2 TXD0 (to the adapter's RX), 3 RXD0 (to the adapter's TX); 3.3 V logic
LED series resistor on IO4 (IO4 is not a strapping pin)
indicator LED, on when IO4 is high
